title: Tenma Tsukasa — Souvenir Excitement〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone! Line up!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start passing out the souvenirs from our trip now!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Emu & Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing back souvenirs for all of us, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, do we all need to line up like this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With the plushies included, there are quite a lot of us, after all. This does seem like a good way to make sure everybody receives their gift.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I'm sensing quite a bit of excitement from them.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: What do you think we're gonna get?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I can't wait to find out!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You see?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, Tsukasa, did you enjoy your trip?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I got to experience autumn with all five of my senses!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In particular, the sight of the mountainside dyed in vibrant scarlet was absolutely stunning!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds so nice♪
The leaves were really that pretty?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they were so inspiring that I was able to come up with another idea for a story.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, another idea?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it takes place at a famed leaf-viewing location.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And the protagonists are all maple leaves.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Leaves...?

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
It's nice and sunny again today☆

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line:
Oh, I feel a nice breeze coming!
That means it's time to do the fun and happy leaf dance!!

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: Wow♪ The way the wind is making the green leaves wave is so beautiful☆

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: Yes, but these are supposed to be even prettier after they've turned red and yellow during the fall!

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: (Everyone's gonna be so happy when we change colors!)

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: Hmm... But a lot of the other leaves are also gonna turn red, so... Alright! That just means I've gotta become even redder than them☆
We won't let you.

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf B
rows.Line: We're also trying to become the reddest leaves here.

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf C
rows.Line: Yeah... That makes us all rivals.

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: Wow...! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: Then, I know! We should have a competition to see who can become the reddest leaf☆

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's always good to have rivals to compete against.

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf C
rows.Line: That also means no holding back, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And so, our heroine began training to become the reddest leaf of all.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “She braved the sun during the day, endured some very cold nights... But then, a fearsome storm rolled in.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “She did her best to stay on her branch, but finally, she was pulled away...”

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line:
No, I have to get back to my branch!
Jump! Jump! Juuump!

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line:
No, I can't reach it...
But I haven't become fully red yet...

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: And I made a promise to the others that I'd try my best...
Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf B
rows.Line: Looks like yesterday's rainstorm made us all fall off...

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: Oh, you did...?

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf C
rows.Line: None of us was able to become completely red. We're all a mix of yellows and oranges...

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: (They all tried their best...)
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Tourist Child
rows.Line: Wait, these leaves aren't red!

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: (They're gonna be so disappointed by how we look...)

rows.Speaker: Tourist Child
rows.Line: Wow♪ They're a really pretty mix of colors!

rows.Speaker: Tourist Child
rows.Line: I'm gonna take them home and keep them as treasures☆

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf C
rows.Line: We're pretty? But we haven't turned red...

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf B
rows.Line: Yes, her reaction tells me that...

rows.Speaker: Maple Leaf A
rows.Line: Hehe... We don't have to be red!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ...is about how that story goes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad for those leaves!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I started tearing up there towards the end!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm honestly surprised by how moving it was...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. I was under the impression that there was going to be a leaf battle royale, with the winner declaring herself the reddest in the blood of her foes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More like a thriller or horror film.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How did you arrive on that?
In any case, a good story must always surpass the viewer's expectations!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, yes...
I probably decided to go with this sort of ending because...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our trip ended up being such a heartwarming and memorable experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm glad that you had such a wonderful trip, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'd be a shame to lose this story. Let's add it to our stock of scripts for later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!
